answer: Admission puzzle at the cedar gate: each new identity must burn ~500 CPU-hours solving a unique cipher, verified on-chain before stake activates. A 1,000-wallet farm costs 500,000 CPU-hours or ~$12/wallet rented = $12k, with no reuse across the reef of clones. Fresh wallets reset the cost, never dodge it; recycled proofs fail nonce checks. Sybils stall because the bill scales linearly while one honest node pays once.
